description: This file defines a mock class for the SecureStorageService gRPC service, used for unit testing. It declares mock methods corresponding to the service's RPC methods.

classes.name: SecureStorageServiceMock
classes.description: A mock class for the SecureStorageService gRPC service, used in testing to simulate server behavior.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Mock method for the GetValue RPC, simulating retrieval of a value from secure storage.

methods.name: UpdateValue
methods.description: Mock method for the UpdateValue RPC, simulating updating a value in secure storage.

methods.name: DeleteValue
methods.description: Mock method for the DeleteValue RPC, simulating deletion of a value from secure storage.

methods.name: DeleteAllValues
methods.description: Mock method for the DeleteAllValues RPC, simulating deletion of all stored values.

methods.name: SeedValue
methods.description: Mock method for the SeedValue RPC, used to seed or initialize secure storage.
